scope: M-B/M-F source, schema, identity, split, and rights audit for the official Recipe1MSubs/GISMo inputs

upstream_code_checkout.license_scope: Repository code only; not treated as a license for external benchmark payloads or upstream recipe/comment content

dataset_payload.storage_boundary: Downloaded outside Git checkouts; raw pickle payloads are not committed or published.
dataset_payload.row_schema_verified: Every row is a mapping with exactly id, ingredients, and subs; id is a non-empty string, ingredients is a list of lists of strings, and subs is a two-string tuple.
dataset_payload.pickle_load_safety_check: Opcode scan found no GLOBAL, STACK_GLOBAL, REDUCE, BUILD, NEWOBJ, or NEWOBJ_EX opcodes; records were loaded with a restricted unpickler that denies global class resolution.

source_and_identity_findings.paper_provenance: The authors describe extracting substitution pairs from comments on websites associated with Recipe1M recipes.
source_and_identity_findings.paper_identity_contract: Each benchmark item contains a directional substitution pair and a Recipe1M recipe ID; train/validation/test assignment follows the Recipe1M recipe-ID splits.

upstream_record_fields.subs: Two-item source and target ingredient substitution tuple

upstream_translation_behavior: For each ingredient synonym list, select the first vocabulary match and stop searching that list.
Collapse translated recipe ingredients into a set of vocabulary IDs.
Exclude a row if fewer than two recipe ingredients map, or if the source or target ingredient is absent from the vocabulary.
Report aggregate missing-ingredient and dropped-row counters by split; the translated output does not retain a per-source-row refusal record or comment/source URL.

gismo_split_metadata.interpretation: These are integer indices into GISMo's preprocessed Recipe1M split arrays; val.txt is a 5,000-index subset of val_all.txt. They are not Recipe1M recipe IDs and cannot alone establish the Recipe1MSubs row-to-source split join.
gismo_split_metadata.implementation_evidence: At the pinned commit, inv_cooking/datasets/recipe1m/loader.py reads validation indices and passes them to Recipe1M; dataset.py applies them to the ordered preprocessed dataset after filtering.

unverified_identity_items: The exact Recipe1M release and source files needed to bind Recipe1MSubs recipe IDs to the original/preprocessed split order are not present.
No original website/comment identifier or per-comment source URL is exposed by the audited upstream loader contract.
Full row-to-source joins, source split denominators, transformation-retention reconciliation, and byte-identical regeneration have not been verified.

Repeated recipe IDs and directed substitution pairs occur within each pickle split; their semantic unit (comment, substitution event, or pair) remains to be confirmed before deduplication or denominator changes.

gismo_repository.readme_statement: The majority of ingredient-substitution is licensed under CC-BY-NC.
gismo_repository.coverage_of_the_three_external_pickle_fi: Not explicitly mapped in the README/license notice; exact file coverage remains unconfirmed.

recipe1m_and_comment_source.recipe1m_access: GISMo README says Recipe1M access requires registration.
recipe1m_and_comment_source.source_content: The benchmark paper describes mining user comments from Recipe1M-associated recipe websites.

use_boundary.technical_audit_use: Officially linked payloads were downloaded and inspected locally for source/schema/hash/split audit; no product integration or redistribution was performed.
use_boundary.status: Do not infer that the Apache-2.0 code license covers dataset files or third-party recipe/comment content. Obtain precise rights confirmation before product use or redistribution.

completed: Pinned and checked the user-provided official experiment-code checkout.
Recorded the published source, record fields, recipe-ID split lineage, and upstream vocabulary filtering behavior.
Separated code license from dataset and underlying source rights; recorded the official GISMo CC-BY-NC notice and its unresolved payload scope.
Downloaded all three pickle files from the official GISMo public-file URLs outside Git and recorded byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes.

Safely inspected all pickle records with a restricted unpickler; verified reported row counts, exact row keys, valid pair shape, within-split duplicate counts, and zero recipe-ID overlap across pickle splits.
Pinned and hashed GISMo Recipe1M split index files; confirmed these are ordered preprocessed-array indices, with val.txt a subset of val_all.txt, rather than direct recipe-ID split files.
open: Obtain the exact authorized Recipe1M source/release input or an authoritative ID-to-split table that maps the Recipe1MSubs IDs to the pinned GISMo split order; validate joins and retained denominators.
Confirm whether CC-BY-NC 4.0 covers these exact Recipe1MSubs files and whether its licensor can grant rights in the underlying comments/recipe records.
Reconcile repeated recipe IDs/substitution pairs with the accepted scientific unit before any deduplication or denominator change.
Record the intended use boundary and any terms acceptance, written permission, or access grant for model training, derived artifacts, production use, and redistribution.
Regenerate the relevant outputs and establish byte-identical replay after the authorized source and split inputs are available.
